mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_DATE AS boardDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R WHERE R.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO ) AS replyCount FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_TYPE = 3 ORDER BY B.BOARD_DATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
